name: Levan Chokheli
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Georgian welterweight (15-4, 1 NC, age 30) out of Kassel, Germany, a Bellator veteran. He knocked out Leon Shahbazyan in 23 seconds in his UFC debut in June.

how_they_fight.Striking: A power puncher: twelve of 15 wins by knockout, eleven of them in R1 in our data.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Decision wins in Bellator came from pressure and some wrestling.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped twice in R1: by Lorenz Larkin (KO) and Goiti Yamauchi (submission).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Three decisions in Bellator; most fights are short.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Front-runner who looks for the early knockout.

patterns: Explosive starts; nearly all finishes in R1
